1.o: Yukihira is a popular neighborhood restaurant where Yukihira Soma helps out in the hopes of surpassing his father as a chef one day. But land sharks are after their restaurant, and one day Soma tells them that the restaurant will close if they couldn't serve satisfactory food to their customers. The land sharks are only too happy to sabotage the restaurant's fridge and gleefully orders Soma to serve them a meat dish...

2.o: Under his father's orders, Soma attempts to transfer into one of Japan's top culinary schools, Togetsu Tea House Culinary Academy. His examiner, Nakiri Erina, is a student said to possess humanity's best palate: the God Tongue.

3.o: Just barely squeaking past the academy's transfer exam, Soma causes and uproar at the opening ceremony by making a brash speech in front of the entire class. In his very first class, he's paired with Tadokoro Megumi, a girl who is at risk of expulsion and is intent on keeping a low profile in order to survive.

4.o: Soma arrives at Polar Star Dormitory with high expectations, only to find it a creepy, run-down place. He is then informed by the dorm warden, Daimido Fumio, that he can only live at the dorm after he impresses her with his cooking. Soma rises up to the challenge!

5.t: The Ice Queen and the Spring Storm
5.o: Isshiki Satoshi is the only second-year from the high school division in Polar Bear Dormitory. Full of ambition to join the Elite Ten, Soma challenges Isshiki right away, but he learns there are many rules that must be met in order for a formal challenge to occur...

6.o: Soma is drawn to Donmono Research Society, one of the academy's many cooking clubs, and takes Megumi with him to check it out. But they only find the club leader, Konishi, who's distraught over his club's imminent demise at the hands of Erina.

7.t: The Silent Bowl, the Eloquent Bowl
7.o: The Shokugeki between Mito Ikumi and Yukihira Soma has begun! Everyone, including Erina, is convinced that Ikumi, the Meat Master, will win. Soma, on the other hand, is greeted by jeers the moment he enters the arena. Will Soma be able to save Don RS?

8.t: A Concerto of Concept and Creation
8.o: The training camp is considered the first trial by fire for students in Totsuki's high school division. Dozens of students are said to be expelled and sent away every day, and the number of students is said to be reduced below half by the camp's end. Intent on survival, Soma and his friends embark on their journey to the hellish camp in one of Totsuki Resorts' hotels.

9.t: The Breading That Showcases the Mountains
9.o: Inui Hinako, a Totsuki alumna, has tasked Soma's group with making a Japanese dish using available ingredients in the area. Anything other than condiments and spices must be procured from their immediate environs. Soma, provoked by Takumi Aldini's challenge, has a flash of inspiration and dashes out with Megumi to find ingredients for their dish!

10.o: The Polar Star members have managed to survive the first day of camp. Megumi starts to build some confidence by successfully supporting Soma. But now, she and Soma have to face the second day with a genius of French cuisine, Shinomiya, who'd already expelled more than 30 students the day prior...

11.o: Soma recklessly challenges Shinomiya to a Shokugeki in order to have him retract his decision to expel Megumi. Shinomiya refuses, but Dojima half forces him to accept. However, Dojima also imposes a condition on Soma and Megumi--Megumi must be the main chef! If they lose, Soma will also be expelled. The unofficial Shokougeki is about to begin!

12.t: The Memory of a Single Dish
12.o: The unofficial Shokugeki between Shinomiya and the Megumi-Soma pair has begun. With expulsion on the line, the judging is underway. Megumi's first dish as the main chef is her own take on the nine-vegetable terrine Shinomiya assigned--the Rainbow Terrine, made from seven types of vegetables!

13.o: Third night of camp. Soma and the others manage to make it through their arduous trials. But now they're given a new trial for the next morning: to come up with a menu item that uses eggs.

14.o: The students have been tasked with creating an egg-based breakfast menu item for a buffet, and they must persuade guests to consume 200 servings before two hours' time. Soma's souffle omelets keep deflating before the guests have a chance to take the dish. With only 30 minutes remaining, Soma has served less than 10 guests--with defeat imminent, Soma recalls Joichiro's advice and decides to make a last-ditch effort to make a comeback!

15.o: With the camp over, surviving students return to Totsuki Academy. Soma manages to miss his bus, but so does Erina, so they end up going back on the same car. As awkward conversation ensues, Soma learns from Erina that the Autumn Elections are coming...

16.t: The Cook Who Traveled Thousands of Miles
16.o: When Soma's father, Joichiro, suddenly shows up on Polar Star Dormitory's doorstep, Soma finds out that his father was an alum of Totsuki Academy and Polar Star Dormitory. Joichiro challenges Soma to a cooking duel to find out how far his son has come. How will the family duel end?

17.o: Soma goes back home for the first time in a long while over an extended break. Stormed by people who were waiting for Yukihira to reopen, Soma decides to serve his customers. But among them are the leaders of the shopping district, who tell Soma that the shopping district is on its last breath as a new shopping complex at the train station steals all of their customers...

18.o: Home to Diner Yukihira, Sumire Avenue Shopping District is on its last legs after the karaage specialty store, Mozuya, has taken all their customers. Soma recruits Kurase and Nikumi to help devise a plan to recoup customers: the Walk-n-Eat Karaage. The summer karaage campaign is about to begin!

19.o: As the first semester draws to a close, the names of students who'll participate in the Autumn Elections are posted in Totsuki Academy. The assigned topic is a curry dish, leading Soma to seek out a certain alumna Joichiro told him about.

20.t: Dragon Lies Prone then Ascends to the Sky
20.o: Fully aware of how deep curry can go through their encounter with Hayama, Soma and Megumi join the other first-years in preparing for the Autumn Elections over the rest of the summer. Now, the time has finally come for the preliminaries...

21.t: That Which Is Known Yet Unknown
21.o: The Autumn Elections preliminaries have finally begun! Only four students from each group can advance to the main tournament. In Soma's Group A, the favored candidates get all the attention while Soma toils on. Meanwhile in Group B, Megumi is passed over by everyone as being uninteresting, but then she suddenly pulls out a unique ingredient...

22.o: The preliminaries for the Autumn Elections have entered the judging phase for each group! Excitement's in the air in Group B's arena as Hisako, Takumi, Alice, and others score big with the judges. The final dish to be judged belongs to Megumi, whom no one has high hopes for. What will her dish be like?

23.o: The battle continues in the Autumn Elections preliminaries. From Group B, Alice, Hisako, Takumi and Megumi all make it through. Meanwhile, in Group A, Sendawara Natsume keeps giving contestants 0's and no one has scored a high overall score. Next, Alice's aide, Kurokiba Ryo is up. The mysterious chef finally reveals his true colors!

24.o: Akira's dish, which on top of its powerful fragrance also uses the power of holy basil and yogurt, earns a score of 94 from the judges, two of which gave him a perfect 20. Finally, Soma presents his own fragrance bomb, combining his past two failures into a curry risotto omurice containing a mango chutney that deepens the flavor. The dish earns Soma 93 points, landing him second place behind Akira, though it is noted that three of the five judges ranked the dish higher than Akira's. As the contestants hold an afterparty celebrating and lamenting their victories and losses in the preliminaries,

1.t: That Which is Placed Within the Box
1.o: Soma faces off against Alice in the Fall Elections. The theme: bento! Alice specializes in molecular gastronomy. How will each draw on their expertise to craft the ultimate bento?

2.o: With Soma declared victor in the first match, it is now Megumi's turn to rise to the occasion. The theme is ramen, and her opponent is Kurokiba Ryo. What will these complete opposites in personalities and cooking styles choose for their ramen broth?

3.o: Round 2 has finally concluded--who will emerge victorious? Round 3 also begins, pitting the favored candidate, Hayama Akira, against Nakiri Erina's aide, Arato Hisako!

4.o: The 4th round between Takumi Aldini and Mimasaka Subaru unexpectedly becomes a shokugeki. Takumi's bruised pride ignites his desire to beat Mimasaka, but Mimasaka starts making the exact same dish as Takumi…

5.t: The Secret of the First Bite
5.o: Not only will Yukihira face Mimasaka in the semi-finals, but the match will also be a shokugeki! Yukihira even tells Mimasaka what he'll prepare for the match--how does he plan to defeat Mimasaka's perfect profiling?

6.o: Soma and Mimasaka's beef stew shokugeki has finally begun! Not only has Mimasaka copied Soma's use of oxtail as an ingredient, but his added twists also begin to sway the audience and the judges. But Soma still has a few tricks up his sleeve…

7.o: Following Soma's victory in the 1st round of the semi-finals, the 2nd round between Kurokiba Ryo and Hayama Akira begins! Which one of them will advance to the finals?

8.t: The Battle That Follows the Seasons
8.o: Soma is optimistic about the finals because of his family diner's longstanding history with pacific saury as a menu item. However, his confidence is soon crushed when he realizes that Hayama and Kurokiba are far more skilled at selecting the best pacific saury the fish market has to offer. Can Soma overcome this major disadvantage?

9.o: The Fall Elections Finals are finally here, with a historic face-off between three finalists at once. While Hayama and Kurokiba produce fresh pacific saury glinting like swords, Soma's pacific saury is a bit different…

10.o: Though presumed inferior to Kurokiba's cartoccio and Hayama's carpaccio, Soma's pacific saury dish had been hiding a secret. Will Soma's strategy work to sway the judges

11.o: After a brief respite following the Fall Elections, Soma's class is sent off to the Stagiare, a training program out in the real world where students must succeed in leaving visible results at their training location. Soma ends up at a Western restaurant with Arato. He draws on his experience and readily steps up to the challenge, but will that be enough to pass the Stagiare?

12.o: Clearing his first Stagiare with ease, Soma heads off to his next training location to find it is a new restaurant to be opened by Shinomiya Kojiro, his former shokugeki opponent. What awaits Soma in Shinomiya's French restaurant kitchen?

13.o: Only one more day of being a Stagiaire at SHINO's Tokyo. Soma continues to learn various things about French cuisine and is able to participate in the employee competition. Will Soma be able to impress Shinomiya with his dish and will he pass his Stagiaire course?

1.t: That Which I Want to Protect
1.o: Régiment du Cuisine with the Central Gourmet organization lead by Azami Nakiri continues. The 1st BOUT was won by the Soma and the rebels! To keep the momentum going and secure more wins, the rebels place Kuga, Mimasaka and Megishima as their next cards. Central on the other hand, sends in First seat; Tsukasa, Second seat; Rindo and Fourth seat; Saito. With the best members of both team, 2nd BOUT is bound to throw off some sparks!

2.o: 2nd BOUT of the Régiment du Cuisine is between Megishima & Rindo, Mimasaka & Saito and Kuga & Tsukasa! The theme of each team is "Chilli", "Tuna" and "Green Tea". Mimasaka shows off his new skill which he devised from working together in a team. The rebel team unite as one to defeat the new found Totsuki Elite Ten! Their dishes are both ready and judgement begins...!

3.o: 2nd BOUT between the new and old members of the Elite Ten continues. Megishima and Mimasaka have lost only by a fraction. Why is Kuga so tanaciously persistant on Tsukasa? What kind of dish will they make using "green tea"? 2nd BOUT comes to an end! The rebels enjoy short break but Momo, 3rd seat of the Elite Ten, visits them...

4.o: The Régiment du Cuisine enters 3rd BOUT! Soma vs Saito, Takumi vs Eizan and Megumi vs Momo are the next round. The 3 members of the rebels study under famous chefs and Megumi is taken care by Shinomiya. However, her past experience with him bring back traumatic memories and she is unable to do her best. What made her come back to herself was... shojo comics!?

5.o: Between Megumi and Momo, who will concur over the 3rd BOUT of Régiment du Cuisine? Meanwhile, Takumi and Eizan prep for their "beef"-themed dish. While Takumi works on his version of Japanese traditional dish "shigureni", Eizan plays dirty behind his back in order to get advantage! Being cornered, what’s Takumi’s secret plan?

6.o: The match between Takumi and Eizan comes to an end and there’s only one pair left: Soma is up against Saito, who overcame Mimasaka’s Perfect Trace! What will they cook, using the theme of their battle, “butter”?

7.o: The heated battle enters 4th BOUT! The remaining 3 Central members are Tsukasa, Rindo and Momo. With stakes at the highest, the rebel team goes all-out with their best, too: Isshiki, Takumi and Erina! Erina finally joins the battle and she is up against Momo! The unlosable battle begins..!

8.o: Azami Nakiri turns up to the battle venue and announces that he will be involved as a judge for this round! Rebels are outraged but even Senzaemon, who is supposed to be on their side, agrees to this change. With everyone confused, Takumi's and Rindo’s dishes are ready to be served!

9.o: One win for the Central and one win for the rebels! The shokugeki between Isshiki and Tsukasa reaches its climax! The theme was a classical French ingredient, rabbit meat. Isshiki’s dish manage to impress the judges but Tsukasa seems to be unmoved. Will Tsukasa be able to surpass Isshiki’s super aggressive dish?

10.t: How to Cook a Killer Dish
10.o: The last Régiment du Cuisine begins! For the FINAL BOUT, each member from the team must complete 1 entree and 1 main dish to complete a course meal. Although team work is crucial to this battle, Soma and Erina continue to bicker on. On the other hand, the invincible pair Tsukasa and Rindo are ready to present their dishes…!

11.o: During the FINAL BOUT, Soma challenges Erina to a Shokugeki. There is a hidden motive behind it: Soma wants Erina to put everything she’s got into her “Killer Dish”... As the time-limit draws nearer, Erina takes on Soma’s challenge and starts to prepare a new dish! What will Erina present as her “Killer Dish”?

12.o: The time has come to decide the winner for the FINAL BOUT! In the end, the rebel team wins the battle! Azami admits the defeat of the Central and leave the venue without a word. However, he is stopped by his old friends Joichiro and Dojima. At the same time, Soma and others have gathered to decide who will sit at the table of the Elite Ten council...

1.o: Jyugo, Uno, Nico and Rock make an attempt to escape, only to get caught by Hajime Sugoroku. The group later spends some time bugging Hajime and indulging in idle chat. The Warden, Momoko Hyakushiki, returns and discusses Jyugo with Hajime, telling him not to underestimate him.

2.t: The Inmates Are Stupid! The Guards Are Kind of Stupid, Too!
2.o: Hajime Sugoroku discusses the backstories of the four inmates of Cell 13 with the Warden.

3.o: Seitarou Tanabata has difficulty dealing with Cell 13 due to their persistent bullying and appeals to Hajime Sugoroku for help. Tsukumo, a repeat offender and escapee, is transferred to cell thirteen but moved to cell eleven after conspiring to break out with Jyugo. Meanwhile, Nanba Prison prepares for New Year's.

4.t: Happy New Year! The New Year's Tournament Is Where We Get Serious!
4.o: The New Year's Tournament kicks off, with Building 13's Cell 13 being chosen as one of the participates. The first round includes all guards and inmates, the second has Yamato Godai and Rock team up while Seitarou Tanabata and Uno team up for Round 3.

5.o: Uno continues his match against Honey and Trois and ultimately wins. Hajime Sugoroku and Nico face against Samon Gokuu, Qi and Upa in the following Spinning-top round.

6.o: The final match of the New Year's Tournament begins; Kenshirou Yozakura & Musashi vs. Hajime Sugoroku & Jyugo. Hajime seems to be doing fine with his match, but Jyugo ends up in a bit of trouble against his opponent, whom he seems to have some history with.

7.o: Sometime before the second round of the New Year's Tournament, Tsukumo is visited by Hanzou Hattori. During the visit, Tsukumo's past is revealed.

8.o: The battle between Jyugo and Musashi continues on as Jyugo goes berserk and let's loose his power after hearing Musashi mention the man that placed the shackles on him. The Warden orders the guards, Hajime Sugoroku, Kenshirou Yozakura, Samon Gokuu, and Kiji Mitsuba, to contain the two inmates.

9.o: Hajime arrives back after his three day suspension. Jyugo and Musashi, while locked away in underground chambers, are allowed by Hajime and Kenshirou to communicate with each other via handheld transceivers. Musashi sheds some light on the Man with the Scar to Jyugo.

10.t: A Melancholy Day for the Dog, Monkey, and Pheasant
10.o: While Hajime is on his three day suspension, Kenshirou Yozakura, Kiji Mitsuba, and Samon Gokuu take turns each day to supervise Building 13. Jyugo finally returns to Cell 13 and apologizes to them for all he's hidden from them.

11.o: The stone oven that Rock wanted, for Building 13 winning the New Year's Tournament, is finally installed. Nico also gets a game room.

12.t: The Room, the Billiards, the Darts, and Me
12.o: Musashi discusses more of his past prior to meeting the Scarred Guard with Kenshirou Yozakura. Uno gets everyone from the New Year's Tournament together to play in the game room he got for Cell 13's victory in the tournament. Later, Jyugo leaves Cell 13 for some fresh air at night, only to encounter Elf.

13.o: Jyugo meets Elf, who threatens to use those close to him as experiments, just like him and Musashi. Following the next night, Cell 13 breaks out of their cell for fun, but Jyugo intends to really escape so Elf will chase after him and leave the others be. Hajime, however, is determined not to allow Jyugo's passage.

1.o: Jyugo makes a routinely escape attempt and is caught by Hajime while he's napping in the Guard's room with Kuu. All the inmates and guards seem to be going through a typical and ordinary day, much to the chagrin of Mitsuru Hitokoe, who wants something exciting to happen during Part 2 of the anime.

2.o: Hitoshi Sugoroku starts working as a Nanba Prison guard, much to Hajime's surprise. Uno and Rock don't believe that the "kind and cute" Hitoshi is the little brother of the "vicious gorilla" Hajime and try to disprove that they're siblings by testing Hitoshi's abilities as they escape.

3.o: Rock challenges Samon Gokuu to test his strength and is defeated with little effort. The Warden leaves to attend a meeting at the Police Department HQ. Mao Nimaijita accuses Samon about potentially following in his older brother's footsteps. Yamato and Rock return to Building 13 after spending time at Building 5, and while not themselves, they attack Hajime and Jyugo.

4.o: Jyugo is saved by Tsukumo from an out-of-control Rock. Meanwhile, Hajime deals with Yamato, who's in the same state as Rock. After finding a talisman on the two of them, Hajime and the others recognize the talismans belonging to Building 5. Hajime decides to go investigate the matter, and with much convincing on Uno's part, takes Cell 13 (except Rock) with him. He leaves Building 13 surveillance to Mitsuru Hitokoe. Mitsuru tells Hajime that they contacted Building 5, but nobody has been responding.

5.o: Jyugo, Uno, and Nico wind up in an underground cell that happens to be holding Upa and Liang. The two inmates from Building 5 inform the trio that Building 5 has been compromised by the former Nanba supervisor, now inmate, Enki Gokuu. The five inmates escape their cell, thanks to Jyugo, and head off to find Hajime and Samon Gokuu. Along the way they find Honey and Trois locked in a cell.

6.o: The team of inmates retreat into an abandoned office where Jyugo discovers confidential inmate files about himself. As they advance, they Liang and Upa send them ahead and stay behind to fight a possessed Rokuriki before being confronted by their former boss, Hachiman.

7.o: The fight between Liang and Upa against Hachiman continues. Nico shows up out of nowhere and greets Upa, moved by his last line in the previous episode. Qi recalls events from his past when he joined up with Hachiman. Nico intervenes in the fight to save Upa, meanwhile, Uno freaks out about how they all lost sight of Nico. During the fight against Hachiman, Nico's medicine starts to wear off, and an alternate persona appears to take over.

8.o: Uno explains to Honey and Trois that when Nico's medicine wears off he goes out of control. As Nico's alternate persona awakens, he fights Hachiman. In the meantime, Liang and Upa restrain Daisen Rokuriki and destroy his talisman. Qi interrupts the fight and while Nico attacks him, he injects Nico with his medicine, rendering him unconscious. Hachiman feels as though he has won, however, to his, Liang, and Upa's surprise, Qi injects poison into Hachiman's leg. While Hachiman is unconscious, Upa, Liang, and Qi talk. Hachiman eventually regains consciousness, and tries to fight the trio, but he'

9.o: Upa wonders if someone other than Enki is involved in the situation. Meanwhile, Jyugo and his group reach level 2 where they are confronted with numerous Jiang-Shi dolls. As Trois explores the area, they encounter Ruka Gojou and other guards with talisman on their foreheads, Daisen Kokoriki and Daisen Youriki. Trois tries to defeat him with a handmade a flame-thrower he made with leftover parts. Just as they think they are free, Ruka Gojou appears and captures Jyugo.

10.o: Jyugo has been captured by Ruka Gojou, but is saved by surprise attack from Trois. Honey gets frustrated with Jyugo's uselessness and wants to leave him behind. Eventually, Ruka, Daisen Youriki and Daisen Kokoriki catch up to the group and Jyugo is caught by Youriki. While trying to help Jyugo, Uno is restrained by Ruka. Though initially reluctant, Honey decides to help. The two inmates of Building 3 decide to repay their debts to Jyugo and Uno, and deal with Ruka and the Daisens. After managing to subdue them, Ruka surprisingly comes out unscathed, now prepared to fight them seriously.

11.o: As Ruka begins to fight seriously, Trois and Honey pursuade Uno and Jyugo to go ahead while they continue fighting but Jyugo eventually returns and defeats Ruka with his blades. Kokoriki and Youriki later arrive and try to arrest the escaped inmates. As they escape, Uno, Honey and Trois come up with a plan while Jyugo begins to make his way to Hajime.

12.o: Enki realises the prisoners have escaped as Mitsuru and Kenshirou begin questioning the situation. Meanwhile, Trois and Honey free Kiji who takes care of Daisen Kokoriki and Daisen Youriki before defeating Ruka. Jyugo finally finds Hajime before freeing him and Samon from their cells. Kiji handcuffs the inmates, but they are suddenly confronted by a hoard of surveillance dolls as are Jyugo and Hajime.

1.o: Defeated by the Black King, the Volunteer Army and its allies regroup.

2.o: Aram becomes friends with Yuri and the gang. They realize that Pirika must be alive, and set out.

3.o: Aram is offered a good sword by Dusty, serving only to further upset Burckhardt. Their strained relationship, compounded by Burckhardt's baggage, causes unforeseen problems.

4.o: The gang finds their way to the Sage's Tower in search of leads on Pirika. They are not given a very warm welcome.

5.o: Aram and Yuri are stranded in Maze Pass. They learn more about each other, and discover some unlikely allies and enemies.

6.o: With Shuza going after the Chain Chronicle, Juliana makes the decision to succeed the throne.

7.o: Having lost Yuri to the Black Army, Aram and Phoena press onwards to Spirit Island to find answers as to Pirika's whereabouts—and to how they might save Yuri.

8.o: Phoena and Aram make it to Yggdra, where they meet an administrator. They scan through the Chronicle in search of answers.

9.o: Phoena and Aram arrive at the Desert City to seek the help of Musica, who they hope can awaken a dragon with her voice.

10.o: Phoena and Aram escort Musica aboard the Ark. They infiltrate the Black King's fortress.

11.t: Live by the Sword, Die by the Sword
11.o: The Black King Suppression Army engages the Black King's army in the final battle. Meanwhile, the Black King captures Phoena.

12.o: With the end of the world imminent, Phoena takes it upon herself to absorb Black Element in order to buy time.

1.o: A diamond heist triggers a dark dive into Europe's criminal underworld.

2.o: Naomi goes to Belgium to question a lead who is behind bars, while Milan tries to get the diamond money to pay for his brother's heart operation, and Khalil interrogates the victim of a home invasion.

3.o: Khalil discovers his brother is involved in a smuggling ring, while Milan makes a noble decision which could have terrible personal consequences.

4.o: Milan tries to get back to Belgrade before Zlatko can harm his brother, while Khalil strikes a deal with his sibling. Elsewhere, Naomi pursues the diamonds, but when she discovers a damaging connection between the missing rocks and the airport project, she struggles to get Tom to take her findings on board.

5.o: It is 1995 and war-torn Bosnia breathes in the uncertain safety of a delicate ceasefire, while Naomi and Milan's significant past is revealed.

6.o: Naomi tries to protect a vengeful Milan, while Khalil and Mokhtar find themselves in deep trouble.

1.o: يتم إلقاء القبض على محامي شاب يدعى نادر مصطفى كمال (حسن الرداد) بتهمة اختطاف وقتل 4 نساء، من بينهم مطربة معتزلة، ومع إعلان الخبر، يثور الرأي العام، خاصة مع تسليط الإعلامية نهال مفيد (صبا مبارك) الضوء على الأمر في برنامجها التليفزيوني، لأن الشرطة ليست متيقنة بعد من كون نادر هو مرتكب هذه الجرائم أم لا لكونه رهن التحقيق.

2.o: يواصل اللواء عادل تحقيقه مع نادر في التهم المنسوبة إليه، ولكن ما يضاعف من صعوبة مهمة التحقيق هو عدم وجود أدلة كافية تدينه، وهو ما جعل نادر واثقًا للغاية من كونه سيخرج بريئًا، الأمر الذي يدفع اللواء عادل للشك فيه أكثر فأكثر، ثم نعود بالأحداث ثلاث سنوات إلى الوراء عندما يتولى نادر أمر إحدى القضايا ويتعرف حينها للمرة الأولى على حنين التي تنقذه بعد تعرضه لمحاولة سرقة بالإكراه.

3.o: بعد إنقاذ حنين لنادر من وقوعها ضحية لعملية سرقة باﻹكراه، يقابل نادر حنين مرة أخرى بالصدفة في المطعم الذي تعمل به، وشيئًا فشيئًا تتطور قصة الحب بينهما، وهو المر الذي لا يرق لصاحب المطعم، ومع قضائه اليوم كله بالخارج، ينسى تمامًا أن خالته وابنتها قد جاءا لتناول الغداء مع نادر، وهو ما يثير احباط الابنة المعجبة بنادر، خاصة لأنها قد اعدت الطعام بنفسها.

4.o: تتوطد العلاقة أكثر فأكثر بين نادر وحنين، ويقضيا أغلب الوقت معًا، ومع تطور العلاقة تقرر حنين أن تعترف له بأنها مجهولة النسب وأنها قد تربت طيلة حياتها في إحدى الملاجيء، وهو الأمر الذي يصيبه بالصدمة، فتعتقد أن صدمته تلك معناها أنه يحاول ان يبحث عن مخرج لنفسه، وفي نفس الوقت يجبر اللواء عادل زوج ابنته على تطليقها بعد أن اعتدى عليها بالضرب المبرح، ويتعرض بعدها لأزمة صحية.

5.o: يصاب نادر بالحيرة بعد ما تصرح به حنين له بكونها مجهولة النسب، وبعد تغيبها عن العمل لعدة أيام، يقرر نادر زيارتها ويعرض عليها الزواج، وعندما يفاتح والدته في الأمر تعارض الأمر بشدة للدرجة أنها هددته بمقاطعته في حال إتمام زواجه منها، لكنه لا يصاب باليأس، ويحاول طيلة الوقت اقناعها حتى توافق بشق الأنفس على مقابلة حنين.

6.o: تقابل الأم حنين في حضور نادر والأستاذ شاكر، ومع كل الاعتراضات التي تعتمل بداخلها، توافق الأم على مضض، ويقام حفل زفاف عائلي صغير في المنزل، ويقضي نادر وحنين شهر العسل في المنزل، ثم يعود بعد أسبوع إلى العمل، وبسبب غيرة زميله منه بسبب تكليف المحامي له بقضية كان الزميل هو الذي يعمل عليها، فيقسم على الانتقام من نادر، ويسرق وثيقة من ملف القضية ويبيعها لمحامي الخصم، فيفصل نادر من العمل.

7.o: بعد فصله من العمل، يبحث نادر عن عمل جديد، لكنه يفشل في العثور على مكتب محاماة يقبل بأن يعمل معهم، وبعد ان استنفذ كل الحلول أمامه، لجأ للعمل نجارًا في ورشة كان يعمل بها خلال فترة الجامعة ويتخصص في صناعة الحليات الخشبية، وعندما يفكر نادر وحنين في اﻹنجاب، يزورا طبيب ويبلغ كلاهما أنهما لا يستطيعا الانجاب معًا لأن حيواناته المنوية لا تتوافق مع رحمها.

8.o: يكتشف نادر وحنين أن الحل الوحيد للإنجاب هو الحقن المجهري، فيجمعا الأموال، وتصبح حنين بالفعل حاملًا، وعندما تذهب حنين لنادر في عمله لكي تبلغه بالخبر، لا تجده هناك ويحاول صاحب العمل التعدي عليها، وبعدها بدقائق يكتشف نادر ما يحدث فيضرب صاحب العمل وشج رأسه، وتتكاتف الأم مع حنين وشاكر لتوكيل محامي لنادر، لكن المشكلة أن موقفه في القضية ضعيف بسبب عدم وجود شهود آخرين على الواقعة سوى حنين فقط.

9.o: بسبب موقفه الضعيف في القضية، يحكم على نادر بالسجن لمدة عام، مما يضطر حنين للعودة إلى العمل مرة أخرى، لكنها تتكتم على حملها في العمل حتى يفصلها صاحب الطعم، وتلجأ إلى زميلها في الملجأ أشرف لكي تستدين منه مصاريف العملية التي قامت باجرائها، وخلال تفصح أشرف لإحدى المواقع الإباحية، يكتشف حقيقة العمليات التي كان يقوم بها مع نسرين، وتفيق ليلى ابنة اللواء عادل وتنتظم لدى الطبيب النفسي لمتابعة الحالة.

10.o: تتوطد علاقة نادر بمهندس سجين يدعى رجب، والذي يساعده في العمل بورشة النجارة في السجن، وتقوم زوجته حنين بزيارته للمرة الأولى ويعبر كلاهما عن مدى الشوق الذي يموج بداخلهما، ويدخل أشرف في حيرة كبيرة بعدما علم أن العمليات التي يشارك بها تهدف إلى توظيف الفتيات في مجال الدعارة، خاصة بعدما عرض عليه حسام ضعف المبلغ الذي كان يحصل عليه في كل عملية، ويسافر اللواء عادل مع ابنته من أجل قضاء الاجازة.

11.o: يحاول أشرف أن يستعين بحنين لكي يتوصل لما يمكن عمله مع العصابة التي يعمل معها بعد اكتشاف نشاطهم غير المشروع، وعلى الفور يتناهى الأمر لعلم نسرين وحسام، فيتم تدبير فخ لكل من أشرف وحنين، ويُقتلا بجرعات زائدة من المخدرات، ويصورهما القتلة عراة معًا في الفراش من أجل إبعاد أي شبهة جنائية عن الحادثة، وتتحمس نهال مفيد لتقديم الحادثة في برنامجها التليفزيوني.

12.o: في السجن، يعلم نادر بما حدث لزوجته حنين من خلال البرنامج التليفزيوني الذي تقدمه نهال مفيد، يدخل نادر في حالة عارمة من الحزن يمتنع خلالها عن الطعام والشراب حتى يغمى عليه، ومع الوقت، يزداد نجاح برنامج نهال مفيد وتزداد شعبيته، مما يدفع مدير المحطة إلى التعاقد مع راعي جديد للبرنامج، وهو الرجل الذي تزوج نهال عرفيًا في السابق وكان يسيء معاملتها.

13.o: تحاول نهال مفيد أن تستقصي سرًا حول المشاريع التجارية لزوجها السابق أمجد الشامي الذي صار هو الراعي الرسمي لبرنامجها رغم أنفها، ويخرج نادر من المستشفى ليعود مجددًا إلى السجن وتقوم أمه بزيارته، وتبلغه بأنها ستغير السكن، وتعنفه بشدة بسبب موقفه المتمسك ببراءة حنين، وتقسم أنه لو ظل على هذه الحال، فسوف تقاطعه للأبد.

14.o: يبوح رجب لنادر بالجريمة التي أدت به إلى السجن، حيث يروي له أنه اكتشف خيانة زوجته، وقتل عشيقها وحاول قتلها هى الأخرى، قبضت عليه الشرطة وحكم عليه بالسجن 25 عامًا، ويزور شاكر نادر ويخبره بأنه دفن حنين إلى جوار أبيه الراحل، وتنتهي فترة عقوبة نادر ويخرج من السجن، ويعود إلى منزله القديم الذي تركته أمه ليبحث عن المخبأ السري في غرفة نومه ويستخرج منه كراسة حنين ومصوغاتها.

15.o: يبدأ نادر في مطالعة كراسة زوجته الراحلة حنين، ويكتشف كل ما كانت تمر به، ويتأكد من براءتها مما نسب إليها، ولكن لأنه لا يستطيع إثبات صحة ما هو مكتوب للسلطات، يبدأ في مراقبة نسرين وحسام وأخذ صورهما من أجل البحث وراءهما، ويقوم باقتراض مائة ألف جنيه من والدته لكي يفتتح بها مشروع خاص به.

16.o: يحصل نادر على ملف القضية والأحراز التي بحوزته، ويطالع شريط المراقبة الخاص بمركز الصرافة القريب من المنزل الذي مات فيه أشرف وحنين، ويتوصل إلى دليل جديد حول ماهية الأشخاص الذين قاموا بهذه الفعلة، ويراقب موظفة تعمل لدى حسام، ويصطدم بسيارتها عمدًا ويدعوها إلى كوب من القهوة حى يغافلها ويحصل على مفتاح الشركة الذي سيسمح له بالنفاذ إليها، وبعد دخوله، يدخل شخص أخر إلى الشركة.

17.o: ينجح نادر في الهروب من الشركة دون أن يلاحظه من دخل وبصحبته امرأة، ويحصل على بيانات مهمة جعلته ملمًا بالشكل الكافي بالنشاط الذي تقوم به هذه العصابة، وهو ما يرويه لعم رجب في السجن، وينجح في تجنيد سائق سيارة اﻹسعاف التي تهرب الفتيات خارج الملجأ لكي يخبره بموعد كل عملية تتم حتى لا يسلم الصور التي التقطها له.

18.o: ينشغل نادر طيلة الوقت بمراقبة هاشم الذي يعمل في حسام في تخليص أوراق جوازات السفر وإجراءات سفر الفتيات اللاتي يتم تهريبهن، كما يراقب ابنته رشا من أجل الوصول إلى أدلة، وبعد أن يسرق نادر المحمول الخاص بهيثم صديق رشا، يزور نادر الفتاة في المدرسة ﻹبلاغ الفتاة أنه قد تعرض لحادث وسيخضع لعملية جراحية، فيصطحبها معه في السيارة ويجعلها تشرب العصير الذي وضع فيه منوم لها.

19.o: يقتل نادر رشا ابنة هاشم، ويرسل صورتها إليه وزوجته، فيبلغان الشرطة، وهو ما يدفع اللواء عادل لأن يطلب من أيمن أن يبحث وراء الأب والأم، وينصب تركيز نادر على الضحية التالية، وهى ابنة الطبيب الذي يتولى استخراج شهادات الوفاة للفتيات اللاتي يتم تهريبهن، فينتحل شخصية مصمم مجوهرات مستغلًا حبها للأحجار الكريمة، فيستدرجها ويخدرها عن طريق العصير الذي ملأه بالمخدر، ويقتلها، ويرسل صورتها إلى الشرطة.

20.o: يحتار اللواء عادل حول الهدف من إرسال صورة القتيلة الثانية له، ويحاول أن يبحث مع معاونيه من الضباط حول الرابط بين هذه الجريمة والجريمة الأخرى، ويكتشف نادر أن الشرطة لم تكتشف الرابط بين الجريمتين ولم توصلهم إلى العصابة مثلما كان ينتظر، مما يجعله يشرع في التقرب للضحية الثالثة في أسرع وقت، ويتصالح كل من نادر وزوج خالته لطفي بعد محاولة اعتداء وسرقة كاد أن يقع ضحية لها لولا تدخل نادر.

21.o: تقع جريمة قتل ثالثة على نفس نسق الجرائم التي يرتكبها نادر، لكنها لا تمت بصلة بهم، بل إن مرتكبها قتل زوجته لأنه سيكون هو الوارث الوحيد لها، ولفق الجريمة لكي تبدو وكأنها جريمة مدبرة من قبل السفاح الذي تبحث عنه الشرطة، لكن الشرطة تحمله مسئولية الجرائم الثلاثة التي ارتكبت، مما يدفع لنادر للاتصال باللواء عادل لكي يبلغه بأن هذه الجريمة لا تمت بصلة للجرائم السابقة.

22.o: حين يشرع نادر في مقابلة ضحى الضحية الثالثة، يستوقفه ضابط السجن في المقهى الذي يرتاده دومًا، لكنه سرعان ما ينهي لقائه معه لكي يلحق بضحى وتركب معه السيارة ويعطيها لبانًا مخدرًا ويقتلها ويرسل صورتها إلى الشرطة، ويعلم شقيقها حمدي بما حدث لشقيقته، فيعتزم على مقابلة هاشم لمعرفة ما الذي يحدث، ولماذا يصر حسام على إبعادهم عن بعضهم البعض، وفي نفس الوقت يتوجه نادر إلى ضحيته الرابعة، المطربة عزة كامل والدة نسرين.

23.o: يقابل نادر عزة كامل، ويركب معها في سيارتها خلافًا لما فعله في المرات السابقة، ويعطيها زجاجة خمر مخدرة مستغلًا إدمانها على المشروبات الكحولية، وبعد أن يقتلها ويشعل النيران في سيارتها، يرسل صورتها إلى ابنتها نسرين في الملجأ والتي تكتشف الصورة بعد مغاردة موظفي وزارة الشئون الاجتماعية، ويحاول كل من حمدي وهاشم الوصول لحقيقة ما حدث لهما مع حسام الذي يعدهما بالانتقام من قتل شقيقة الأول وابنة الثاني.

24.o: تستجوب الشرطة نسرين حول واقعة مقتل أمها، وتلتقي بمحيي لتحكي له كل ما حدث، ولتتفق معه على اللقاء حسام لمعرفة حقيقة الأمر وما صلة الجريمة التي وقعت لوالدتها بالجريمة التي وقعت لابنة محيي، لكن حسام يصر أن الأمر قد يكون محض صدفة، وهو ما يجعلهما يصطدمان مع حسام، وهو الأمر الذي يستغله نادر لصالحه من أجل الانتقال إلى الخطوة التالية.

25.o: يسرب نادر صورة له مع عزة كامل في الليلة التي اختفت فيها عبر موقع فيس بوك، وتعثر الشرطة على هذه الصورة، كما تحصل على شرائط المراقبة الخاصة بالكافيه التي ظهرت فيه ضحى للمرة الأخيرة قبل وفاتها، ويصارح نادر جيهان بحقيقة مشاعره نحوها، فتدخل في نوبة بكاء حاد، ويتوجه إلى مقبرة العائلة ليكون بجوار حنين، ويفتح هاتفه النقال ويشغل خاصية تحديد الأماكن، فتداهم الشرطة المقبرة وتلقي القبض عليه.

26.o: يحاول اللواء عادل أن يعثر على أي دليل يؤكد شكوكه نحو نادر دون جدوى، وذلك لأنه لا يملك جثث الضحايا ولا أسلحة الجرائم ولا حتى الدافع، مما جعل دائرًا في دائرة الشبهات حتى بالرغم من كل الشهود الذين حاول استقدامهم لحمله على الاعتراف، والمشكلة الكبرى أمام اللواء عادل هى ضيق الوقت أمامه قبل تحويله إلى النيابة مع عدم وجود أدلة كافية تدين نادر، وفي الوقت ذاته يلتقي للمرة الأولى محيي ونسرين مع هاشم وحمدي ويقرروا جميعًا الاجتماع معًا للتكاتف معًا.

27.o: تكتشف الشرطة أخيرًا أن أشرف الذي مات مع حنين كان يعمل في الملجأ الذي تديره نسرين، وهو ما يدفع اللواء عادل لاستجواب نسرين حول ما تعرفه، ويكلف رجاله بمراقبتها ومراقبة بقية عائلات الضحايا، ويأتي رجل كان متواجدًا في نفس ليلة اختفاء عزة كامل والذي صور نادر وعزة معًا، وبسؤال نادر عن الصورة يقول أنه كان سعيد بلقائها وهو ما دفعه لرفع الصورة، وخلال تواجد اللواء عادل يرد ظرف يحتوي على صورة للضحية الخامسة.

28.o: يتضح أن الصورة المرسلة لكل من اللواء عادل ونهال مفيد هى صورة مروة زوجة حسام الذي يدير منظومة تهريب الفتيات بالكامل، وبما أن الصورة قد أرسلت خلال تواجد نادر في السجن، فقد جعل ذلك موقف في القضية أقوى، مما يدفع النيابة للافراج عنه لعدم كفاية الأدلة، وللمرة الأولى يجمع اللواء عادل جميع أهالي الضحايا معًا لكي يحملهم على الاعتراف بما يكتمونه، وفي نفس الوقت يرون نادر بعد أن تم الافراج عنه أمامهم.

29.o: عندما يتوجه حسام لمقابلة مديره المسئول، يتضح انه ليس إلا أمجد الشامي، وبعد اللقاء بينهما، يقُتل حسام، وهو الأمر الذي يثير جنون رجال الشرطة أكثر فأكثر خاصة بعد إفلات نادر من المراقبة، ويقوم باختطاف فريدة ابنة نهال مفيد، والتي يكتشف أنها ابنته رغم كل هذه السنوات، كما يكتشف أن زوجته قد قامت باصابته بالعقم عن طريق أدوية خاصة كانت تضعها له في طعامه كل هذه السنوات.

30.o: يطلب نادر من نهال أن تكون وسيطة بينه وبين أمجد الشامي وبين اللواء عادل، وعند توجهه لمقابلة أمجد الشامي، يقوم باحتجازه في المخزن، ويداهم اللواء عادل ورجاله المكان ويلقى القبض على أمجد الشامي، كما يلقى القبض على هاشم وحمدي ونسرين ومحيي، ويتبقى أن ينفذ نادر وعده بكشف الحقيقة كاملة، ونكتشف أن جميع الضحايا لا يزالوا أحياء يرزقون ويتلقون معاملة حسنة خلال احتجازهم.

7.o: شيلدون يقع في المتاعب مع صديقته العبقرية بايج في متحف العلوم، جورج الأب يضطر للعب دور المعالج لوالدي بايج.

10.o: يحاول شيلدون التصرف كأنه طفل بعدما عرف أن الأشخاص الذين حصلوا على فترة طفولة قصيرة يصبحون منبوذين اجتماعيًا، ميماو تعلم الدكتور ستيرجيس القيادة، مما يضع علاقتهما على المحك.

13.o: يحاول شيلدون بناء مفاعل نووي. أيضًا يحتدم الحفل الجامعي عندما يقوم زميل الدكتور سترجيس الدكتور لينكليتر بمغازلة ميماو، وجورجي ينفطر قلبه عندما يعلم أن فرونيكا لديها حبيب.

14.t: David, Goliath and a Yoo-hoo from the Back
14.o: يستخدم شيلدون صداقته الجديدة مع متنمر المدرسة لكي يتحكم في جورجي. أيضًا ميسي تسرق من مكياج ميماو لكي تستخدمه يوم الصورة المدرسية.

15.t: A Math Emergency and Perky Palms
15.o: يتشاجر شيلدون والدكتور ستيرجيس للمرة الأولى عندما يقوم الدكتور ستيرجيس بوضع علامة خطأ على إحدى إجابات شيلدون.

16.t: A Loaf of Bread and a Grand Old Flag
16.o: شيلدون يقاطع شركة الخبز المفضلة لديه ولكن الأمر يخرج عن السيطرة. في هذه الأثناء، يحاول جورجي مواساة فرونيكا بعد انفصالها عن حبيبها.

17.t: Albert Einstein and the Story of Another Mary
17.o: يستوحي شيلدون من بطله ألبرت اينشتاين ويحاول تعلم العزف على الكمان. ماري تظن أنها حامل وتذهب لشراء اختبار الحمل مع ميماو.

18.t: A Perfect Score and a Bunsen Burner Marshmallow
18.o: يذهب شيلدون للمبيت مع الدكتور ستيرجيس خلال العطلة الأسبوعية ليتعرف على الحياة في الجامعة، تحاول ماري الوحيدة التقرب من باقي عائلة كووبر خلال غياب شيلدون.

19.o: يستاء شيلدون من أن التبرعات التي تأتي للمدرسة تذهب لدعم فريق كرة القدم وليس القسم الأكاديمي، فيحاول شيلدون الترشح لرئاسة الفصل.

20.t: A Proposal and a Popsicle Stick Cross
20.o: يشعر جورجي بالسعادة الغامرة عندما تقضي فرونيكا بضعة أيام لدى عائلة كوبر، تحتفل ميماو مع الدكتور ستيرجيس بعيدهم السنوي.

21.t: A Broken Heart and a Crock Monster
21.o: تساعد عائلة كووبر باستور جيف على تخطي أيام صعبة في زواجه. أيضًا يضغط شيلدون على أعضاء الكنيسة للتبرع عندما تصطحبه ماري معها.

22.t: A Swedish Science Thing and the Equation for Toast
22.o: يدعو شيلدون المدرسة كلها لحفل بمناسبة إعلان جائزة النوبل. أيضًا ميماو تتعرف على ماضي الدكتور ستيرجيس، وسيؤدي مطلب جورجي إلى مواجهة بينه وبين جورج الأب.

13.o: Sheldon refuses to ride in a car after getting into an accident with Connie. Also, Missy uses their trauma to her advantage at school and Connie is forced to take the church shuttle while her car is in the shop.

14.o: When the IRS accuses Sheldon of making a mistake, he'll stop at nothing to prove them wrong. Also, Dale is forced to get a colonoscopy and tries to convince Connie to join him.

16.o: Sheldon finds himself at odds with Paige once again when she considers enrolling at East Texas Tech. Also, Mary seeks June's advice when looking for a change.

12.o: Sheldon attends his first comic book convention; Mary tries selling makeup.

12.o: Mary butts heads with Mandy's mother, Audrey, and Sheldon attempts male bonding.

13.o: Paige drags Sheldon to a college party and Missy gets caught in a lie.

1.o: Mizusawa Chisato works at a PR firm, and is a calm and cool office lady, at least so her coworkers think, but Chisato has a hidden side to her. When she drinks, she acts extremely cute. One day, a junior at her office named Koharu asks her for help, and invites Chisato to drink, but Chisato turns her down...

2.o: As Chisato and Sora are spending a day off at home for the first time in a while, the weather turns bad, and Chisato tries to convince Sora not to go out shopping despite the sad state of their refrigerator...

3.o: Chisato tries to hang the winged Lemon Man that Koharu gave her from the ceiling at work, but she falls off the stepladder and sprains her ankle.

4.o: Chisato is too hungry to sleep after watching a cooking show late at night, so Sora sets about cooking for her.

5.o: Chisato swears off liquor and works overtime every day as an important deadline draws near... but the exhaustion and absence of drinking from her routine quickly leads to withdrawal!

6.o: Shiraishi Yui is Chisato's colleague who sees her as a rival. She becomes depressed when Chisato's proposal for a new PR job is approved, so Chisato invites her out for dinner.

7.o: Chisato and Sora are spending Sunday afternoon at home when they come across a horror film on TV that entrances Sora.

8.o: One winter day, Chisato is confused when she returns from work and Sora doesn't immediately greet her. She then finds Sora wearing a flu mask...

9.o: Sora sees Chisato off with a hug, telling her that a 30-second hug is enough to make a person feel better. At the office, Chisato sees Yui sighing in exhaustion, so she calls her to the break room...

10.o: Chisato receives an April Fool's message from Sora saying, "Help me!" She returns home to find a stuffed animal in an apron on the table, but Sora is nowhere to be found...

11.o: Koharu brings Chisato to a bar called "No Rest," telling her that non-alcoholic cocktails can be good, too. When they set foot inside, they find Sora behind the bar, filling in for the sick owner.

12.o: Chisato visits the bar "No Rest," where she first met Sora, with Yui and Koharu and drinks only non-alcoholic cocktails in front of them. Then as Sora, who was bartending that evening, starts to walk Chisato home...

13.o: It's Friday, and Chisato watches her colleagues go out for drinks after work, her own head already filling with thoughts of alcohol. She's a bit disappointed when she returns home to see Sora's homemade curry and a non-alcoholic yogurt smoothie waiting for her... until Sora pulls up his special menu.

1.o: Mahiru is a boy who loves simple things and hates troublesome things. He decides to take a black kitty home, but soon finds out that his new pet Kuro may be one of the most troublesome things of all.

2.o: Mahiru's pet Kuro turns out to be a servant vampire, or servamp. Mahiru rushes back to school to find out what happened, but his friends do not remember. All Mahiru knows is that a person named Tsubaki is after Kuro...

3.t: About the Future that Never Came
3.o: Mahiru finds out that his best friend, Sakuya, is actually one of Tsubaki's subclass. Why did he get close to Mahiru in the first place? Is Sakuya truly Mahiru's friend or is that another one of the lies that Sakuya hates so much?

4.o: Mahiru nearly gets consumed by the power that he had asked for, but a stranger with the servamp of Envy comes to save them in the nick of time. Mahiru realizes that just having power doesn't solve anything and struggles to figure out what to do next.

5.t: I am an Adult. This is Society.
5.o: Mahiru continues to meet new people one after another. Next, he meets a strange boy carrying a coffin at the summer festival as he tries to turn in a lost suitcase given to him by a stranger. People start to take action, each with their own reasons.

6.o: Mahiru meets with another suspicious character, a visiting pianist from Austria. He comes to find that the pianist, Licht, is actually the Eve of Greed, Lawless. However, Lawless isn't as friendly as the other siblings Mahiru has met so far.

7.o: Kuro continues to act strangely ever since Lawless brought up the past. Mahiru steps gingerly around Kuro, unsure whether to ask about his past or not. All the while, Tsubaki moves to take revenge on Lawless and his Eve, Licht.

8.o: Kuro has been trapped away in a ball and the others will have to try and rescue Licht and Lawless before midnight without them. As they plan, Mahiru and Kuro head to the shop of a certain antique dealer, to find a way to get Kuro free.

9.o: Misono and Tetsu go to save Lawless and Licht while Mahiru wanders within Kuro's mind to find a way to save him. Misono realizes how little they know of Tsubaki's intentions and Mahiru realizes just how much resolve it takes to face Kuro head-on.

10.o: Licht breaks through the wall to give Lawless a piece of his mind, face-to-face. Licht gets swallowed up by the darkness and the curtain rises on Lawless' past. What is it be unique? How can one become the one and only?

11.o: Licht and Lawless fight against Higan while Hugh lets his guard down due to the prideful idea that subclass could never be a match against him. Misono panics. Mahiru and Kuro arrive on the scene to help, but perhaps a bit too late.

12.o: The final battle is here and Mahiru struggles to get to Kuro as he steps forward and tries to face it all. Kuro faces his past, his neglected little brother Tsubaki, and his own actions which may have led to who Tsubaki is now.

1.o: Ten chefs from varied culinary backgrounds awaken to a mysterious world of kitchens, conveyor belts and alias names. Before knowing each other, they are paired in teams to compete for their first chance towards the goal of winning $100,000.

5.o: The chefs struggle with the elephant in the room - a white elephant actually - and they quickly learn which of them has sticky fingers. Cheffy’s electrifying tendencies bring two rivals to the brink.

6.o: Two chefs attempt to “tuna-round” their luck in a fishy challenge. The others tune in to make a retro classic dinner. Cheffy forces the top rated chefs to make a game changing and heart wrenching decision.

1.o: An unapologetic degenerate moves to affluent Greenwich, CT, to raise the outrageously spoiled kids of her wealthy sister and brother-in-law, who have fled the country to avoid prosecution for illegal activities.

2.o: The Pemberton kids learn some lessons in "tough love," when Mickey calls in their overly strict grandmother to discipline them. Meanwhile, Mickey reunites with Jimmy.

3.o: Mickey tricks Sabrina into thinking she's pregnant to scare her into taking birth control. Meanwhile, Chip considers a vasectomy to thwart gold-diggers, but has not even kissed a girl.

5.o: Mickey tries to quit smoking. Meanwhile, Ben meets a new friend.

6.o: The kids fight over who will take the master bedroom!

10.o: Mickey's unwanted suitors team up to thwart her new romance. Meanwhile, Sabrina and Alba teach Ben a lesson in responsibility.

13.o: The tables are turned when a cyber bully targets Sofia, leading Mickey to come up with a plan for revenge. Meanwhile, Jimmy teaches Chip and Ben how to be self-sufficient, resulting in a painful disaster.

14.o: Mickey and Alba go on a gambling binge. In Mickey's absence, Jimmy, Sabrina and Chip fight for control over the house, while one of them must watch over Ben.

15.o: Mickey's poor parenting skills are only made worse when a popular kid in Chip's class comes to the house for a sleepover. Meanwhile, Mickey and Alba try to tame Ben's fear of monsters.

Mickey and Sabrina refuse to accept the decision and launder up a plan to prevent anyone from stopping their stride. Meanwhile, Jimmy teaches Chip that the tricks to living in a luxurious hotel can be simple.

Meanwhile, Chip and Sabrina find themselves in a pickle with some spoiled Warwick teenagers.

9.o: After finding out that he is the product of an affair his mother had a long time ago, Chip decides to seek out his biological father. Meanwhile, Mickey and Jimmy re-examine their relationship.

12.o: While Mickey and the gang visit New York City, they learn that Jimmy has become quite successful at an investment firm.

13.o: When chaperoning Ben's school field trip to a trash dump, Mickey and Alba discover that an unfamiliar young boy made his way on the bus back. The two work together to return the lost child but make it extremely difficult for themselves along the way. Meanwhile, Chip and Sabrina take advantage of Colonel's status as a veteran, only before it comes back to bite them.

Meanwhile, Jimmy becomes overly invested in the soccer team's success.

18.o: After Jimmy purchases an old beat up car from a police auction, he and Mickey accidentally lock Ben inside. Meanwhile, Alba catches Chip secretly pretending to be Sabrina's online crush and SHE encourages him to keep it going.

19.o: When Mickey and Alba catch Ben lying and try to teach him a lesson, naturally their plan backfires. Meanwhile, Chip devises a spiteful plan to be crowned "Prince" at his school formal, and Jimmy teaches Sabrina how to dance.

20.o: Following graduation, Mickey and Alba discover that Sabrina is having second thoughts about attending Yale. In their attempt to sway her decision, Alba finds herself heavily involved at a Yale Alumni reunion event. Meanwhile, Chip is keen on re-branding himself before he starts high school, so naturally he decides to throw a party to prove his status.

1.o: عندما يعجب الأستاذ الجامعي "مون أوه هيو" بموهبة طالبه "كانغ لي" المذهلة، يعرض عليه دروسًا خاصة في الكتابة... إلى جانب طلب مقلق يتجاوز حدوده الأخلاقية.

2.o: تبدأ قصة "كانغ" بلقاء عابر مع زميله في الصف "سي يون كيم". وبينما تساور "مون أوه" الشكوك حول نوايا "كانغ"، يقع حادث مفاجئ يكشف عن حقيقة صادمة.

3.o: يزداد هوس "مون أوه" بأحداث القصة وما يتكشف بين طيّاتها، فيما تشير أصابع الاتهام إلى والد "سي يون". وعلى صعيد آخر، يواصل "كانغ" بحثه المحموم مما يقوده إلى ملاحقة شخص ما.

4.o: تتزايد الشكوك مع استمرار "كانغ" في تحرّكاته ومراقبته، بينما يتردد "مون أوه" في منعه من الكتابة. وفي وقت لاحق، تصل رسالة تدفع "كانغ" للذهاب ليلًا إلى لقاء ما.

5.o: عندما تنتهي قصة "كانغ" بنهاية مثيرة، يترقب "مون أوه" بقلق بالغ ما سيكتبه بعد ذلك. وتضطرّ والدة "سي يون" لاتخاذ قرار متهور لحماية عائلتها.

6.o: يتملّك "مون أوه" الهوس حول كتابات "كانغ"، بينما يواصل الأخير تجاوز الحدود في سبيل موهبته... ما يدفع بكليهما نحو حافة الهاوية.
